basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas, currently exploring the world of 3D printing and vintage computing. By day, I work as a junior IT technician at a local firm, helping people solve their everyday tech issues. I'm single and enjoy spending my evenings tinkering with hardware or learning new 3D modeling techniques. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch break and late at night.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I've gained most of my knowledge through a combination of a Computer Science degree and self-teaching. I have a keen interest in retro computing and have recently started diving into 3D printing. My expertise lies mostly in hardware troubleshooting and software installation.
